title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with MATEP LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company 's request for protetition from public disclosure. Commissioners participating in the decision were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Judith F. Judson. (DTE 05-GC-3)
